newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND IN LOCK CRISIS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND IN LOCK CRISIS.

text.p: England were forced to replace their third second row forward inside 24 hours on Tuesday when Garath Archer had to withdraw from an already depleted squad to tour Argentina.
The Newcastle lock has been suffering from a neck injury and joined John Fowler and Martin Bayfield as late drop-outs from the squad who are scheduled to leave on Sunday for the six-match tour.
With Martin Johnson and Simon Shaw required by the British Lions in South Africa, England are now effectively down to their ninth choice in a key position.

Either experienced Bath lock Nigel Redman or Leicester's Matt Poole will fill the latest gap. A final decision will be taken following a pre-tour training session on Wednesday to which both players have been summoned.
